author: The Infographics Show
description:
What does your body say about you before you even speak?

From handshakes and posture to eye contact and personal space, male body language is packed with subtle signals that reveal confidence, dominance, stress, and even attraction.
Science shows that everything from your height to your beard can shape how others perceive you, often within seconds.

This breakdown of the weirdest facts about male body language dives into the hidden cues men use every day. From dominant handshakes and “manspreading” to the surprising tells of attraction like dilated pupils, reduced blinking, and subconscious mirroring.

Because whether it’s confidence, nerves, or interest, your body is always talking.
